text: BAM share rose 1.86 percentage points over 27 hours and 1.48 percentage points over 7 days, now at 37.4%. Concentration is elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 24.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The top-node record shows 66 whale-driven leadership changes, so leader movement should be read as routing by large validators, not a structural rollover.
